title: Best Tabletop Game Designers (2026): Board Games and RPG Help
description: How to hire help for board games, card games or tabletop RPGs: game design, rules writing, playtesting, art, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Tabletop game freelancers help create board games, card games and tabletop role-playing content: designing mechanics, writing clear rules, building adventures and maps, balancing cards and preparing files for printing. Some also run online game sessions. Good tabletop games are easy to learn and fun to replay. Projects go wrong when rules are unclear, the game is not playtested, or print files do not meet the manufacturer's specs. This guide helps you build a tabletop game people enjoy.

faq.q: Can they design my whole game?
faq.a: Some designers create full games; others help with mechanics, rules, balance or adventure writing. Clarify the scope.
It reveals confusing rules, unfair strategies and slow turns that designers cannot see alone.
Often a separate illustrator. Coordinate art with card and board layouts early.

faq.q: Can they prepare files for printing?
faq.a: Ask for print-ready files that match your manufacturer's templates.
Agree in writing on ownership of rules, art and content.
